page_title: PSG 6-0 MNT | PSG v Montpellier 23/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) poorly executes the free kick and the ball only hits the wall.
90+5' The players claim that Willian Pacho (PSG) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Free kick. Montpellier will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90+4' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90+1' Benjamin Lecomte pulls off a great save to deny Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Kang-In Lee (PSG) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
88' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Now PSG have a corner.
88' PSG take a short corner kick.
88' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save. It will be a corner kick for PSG.
87' Desire Doue (PSG) latches onto a short pass from Fabian Ruiz inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
83' The substitution is prepared. Gabriel Bares (Montpellier) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Teji Savanier.

82' 6 - 0 Achraf Hakimi passes to Kang-In Lee (PSG), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes inside the right post. Fabulous goal! The score is 6:0.
81' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marc Bollengier saw the whole situation.
80' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) takes the resulting free kick, but no praise for this shot as it blazes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.

79' A player from Montpellier commits a rough challenge. Marc Bollengier blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. PSG win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
78' Substitution. Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) on for Warren Zaire-Emery.

77' Desire Doue plays a lofted pass into the six-yard box. Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) gets his head on the ball but balloons it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
75' Some great play by Desire Doue (PSG) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
74' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

73' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) doesn't hesitate and begins a run towards the opponent's goal. Defenders try to tackle him, but he manages to keep the ball at his feet and pulls the trigger in front of the goal. The strike, though, was not as successful as the solo run and the ball is easily stopped by the keeper. Montpellier have been awarded a corner kick.
71' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.

70' Nuno Mendes (PSG) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
69' Akor Adams (Montpellier) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Gianluigi Donnarumma.
68' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fabian Ruiz (PSG) will replace Joao Neves.
68' Here's the change. Jordan Ferri leaves the pitch and Yanis Issoufou (Montpellier) comes on as a substitute.
68' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to substitute Arnaud Nordin and he is replaced by Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Wahbi Khazri departs the field of play to be replaced by Akor Adams (Montpellier).

67' Nice individual effort by Desire Doue (PSG). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a shot to the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
67' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes the corner which is cleared.
66' Desire Doue (PSG) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. PSG win a corner.
66' Total attempts – 11:2. The current number of shots on goal is 5:1.
64' That was close. Kang-In Lee (PSG) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
64' A quickly taken corner by PSG.
63' Unlucky! A great strike from Joao Neves (PSG) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
63' PSG enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
62' Here comes a substitution. Marco Asensio is given a rest as he is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG).
62' Here is a change. Ousmane Dembele is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Kang-In Lee (PSG).
62' Substitution. Bradley Barcola did his best and is replaced by Desire Doue (PSG).

60' 5 - 0 Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Benjamin Lecomte is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 5:0.
58' 4 - 0 What a goal! Nuno Mendes plays it to Achraf Hakimi (PSG), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Benjamin Lecomte into the right side of the goal. 4:0.
57' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
55' It must be a yellow card. It is. Ousmane Dembele (PSG) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
53' 3 - 0 Goal! Ousmane Dembele puts the ball across the area and Bradley Barcola (PSG) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 3:0.
50' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) has tested the patience of referee Marc Bollengier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
49' Marc Bollengier interrupts the game. One of the players from PSG won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
48' Great teamplay by PSG as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Marco Asensio (PSG) unleashes a powerful shot from the free kick but it only hits the defensive wall.
45+3' Marco Asensio (PSG) takes a short run up and tries to place the ball from the free kick, but the defensive wall blocks the effort. Handball! A player from Montpellier handled the ball.
45+1' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marc Bollengier had an easy-decision to make.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

44' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the right side of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte is well positioned to make a comfortable save. PSG force a corner. They send men into the box.
42' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

41' Good chance! Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
39' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' Marco Asensio (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
39' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
37' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Marquinhos (PSG) latches onto the free kick from Achraf Hakimi, but heads just wide of the left post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) was quite harsh and Marc Bollengier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
31' Joao Neves (PSG) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. PSG win a corner kick.
31' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes.
29' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
29' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will deliver the corner kick.

28' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The ball is out of play and Montpellier manage to earn a corner.

28' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.

26' Close! Bradley Barcola (PSG) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
24' 2 - 0 Goal! Joao Neves plays a pass to the feet of Marco Asensio (PSG) and he shoots low into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 2:0.
23' PSG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

23' Nuno Mendes (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. PSG have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
21' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) commits a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.

18' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
17' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
16' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
15' The ball is cleared after Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
13' Marc Bollengier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier).
12' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' 73:27 – the latest ball possession ratio.

10' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) unleashed a poor free kick shot from far out. He intended to threaten the goalkeeper, but instead sent the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
9' A player from Montpellier pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. PSG are awarded the free kick.
8' Joao Neves (PSG) leaps to meet the corner from Ousmane Dembele, but plants his header just over the bar from close range. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
8' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
7' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Achraf Hakimi (PSG), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
6' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

4' 1 - 0 Bradley Barcola (PSG) displayed brilliant individual skill before finding himself in a great position to strike from inside the box. He produced a terrific shot which went in off the right post, leaving Benjamin Lecomte stranded. The score sheet now reads 1:0.
